scope: Actual compiled UI and isolated SQLite API/worker; only discovery and virtual transport are redirected to owned loopback processes. Generated accounts, not public demo credentials.
checks: Actual Player upload uses its verified session; exact approved artwork passes processing and is pending, private, and not published automatically.
Selecting a new photo clears only confirmed presentation/acknowledgement state; no second upload occurs without a new review.
A real Spectator account cannot see or fetch a pending Player photo.
A real Manager must fetch and review the exact private image before explicit approval adds it to the permitted gallery.
A newly opened actual Spectator album can fetch the approved image through the authenticated gateway.
Player can explicitly withdraw an own pending photo; a published submission offers no invalid withdrawal and keeps the existing manager-removal policy.

An authorized Manager explicitly removes the published image; it leaves the permitted gallery and the same Spectator token can no longer fetch its former route. Existing screenshots or in-memory views are not claimed to be recalled.
